title: Feature added: Wheel alignment and Diagnostics photo stages
description: Two new photo stages have been added to the photo workflow — Wheel alignment and Diagnostics — so photos taken during those specific parts of a job now get their own dedicated grouping instead of being lumped into the Extra category.

title: Feature added: paginated All Vehicles page
description: A new /Vehicles page lets you browse all vehicles chronologically, paginated 25 at a time, so you can look through older work without having to search by VIN or registration number.

title: Feature added: current stage column on vehicle lists
description: The home page vehicle lists now show each vehicle's current workflow stage (Checkin, Quote, Progress, Checkout, or Extra) based on its most recent photo, so you can see at a glance where it stands without opening the Details page.

title: Feature added: live vehicle search suggestions on the home page
description: As you search for a vehicle on the home page, a dropdown now shows matching suggestions in real time, letting you jump straight to the vehicle without waiting for a full search results page.

title: Feature added: untagged-photo badge on the home page
description: A small badge on the home page's vehicle tables now shows how many untagged photos each vehicle has, with a link to jump straight to the tagging worklist.

title: Feature added: fuzzy home-page search by fragment/make/model
description: Search now finds vehicles by partial VIN/Reg fragments and make/model substring (case-insensitive), with up to 25 results returned when multiple matches are found.

title: Feature ideas
description: Suggest a new feature and help review it -- a fuller write-up gets drafted automatically for anything sent back for changes, and once you give final approval, it's queued up to be built.

title: Automatic daily backups
description: Every photo is now backed up automatically each day to a separate, secure location -- with a tested way to restore production if anything ever goes wrong.

title: Simpler part picker
description: Tagging a photo to a part is now one clean dropdown, everywhere -- faster and more reliable than the old visual picker.

title: Damage marking
description: Click a part to record damage against it -- pin the exact spot on a real photo, or leave a note if there's no photo yet.

title: Job cards & photo comments
description: Keep a running log of notes on a vehicle, and comment directly on individual photos.

title: Photo tagging & coverage map
description: Tag photos to the exact part of the car they show, and see at a glance which parts still need photos.
